name: DataTable
description: `DataTable` is a presentational, typed table for stable row data. It owns native table structure, sorting state, and column layout while `Table` exposes structural parts for custom composition.

props.name: bulkActionsProps
props.description: Labels for the bulk actions toolbar.

props.name: bulkActionsReturnFocusRef
props.description: Element that receives focus when a focused bulk action disappears. Defaults to the select-all checkbox.

props.name: cellPadding
props.description: Vertical spacing inside cells, which sets the density of the table.

props.name: collapsibleGroups
props.description: Adds disclosure buttons that show and hide each group's rows. Groups start expanded.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column definitions, giving each column its header, width, and how to read a cell from a row.

props.name: data
props.description: Rows, row groups, or a mixture of both, in display order.

props.name: defaultExpandedGroups
props.description: Ids of the groups expanded on first render. Defaults to every group in the initial data.

props.name: defaultSelectedRows
props.description: Ids selected on first render, when the table owns its selection. Intended for static, single-page data.

props.name: expandedGroups
props.description: Ids of the expanded groups, for when the caller owns the expanded state.

props.name: externalSorting
props.description: Stops the table sorting `data` itself, for when rows arrive already sorted by a server.

props.name: getRowId
props.description: Reads a stable identity from a row. Supply it when rows have no `id` field.

props.name: gridTemplateColumns
props.description: Explicit column track sizes, as a CSS grid template.

props.name: initialSortColumn
props.description: Column sorted on first render.

props.name: initialSortDirection
props.description: Direction sorted on first render.

props.name: isRowSelectable
props.description: Decides whether a row can be selected. Rows are selectable by default.

props.name: onExpandedGroupsChange
props.description: Called with the requested expanded groups when a reader shows or hides a group.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the requested selection when a reader selects or deselects rows.

props.name: onToggleSort
props.description: Called with the column and new direction when a sortable header is activated.

props.name: renderBulkActions
props.description: Renders actions for the selected rows in place of the column headers while any row is selected.

props.name: rowSelection
props.description: Adds a checkbox column for selecting rows.

props.name: selectedRows
props.description: Ids of the selected rows, for when the caller owns the selection.

props.name: cellPadding
props.description: Vertical spacing inside cells, which sets the density of the table.

props.name: gridTemplateColumns
props.description: Explicit column track sizes, as a CSS grid template.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the group of actions.

props.name: getSelectedCountLabel
props.description: Formats the announced selection count.

props.name: onFocusReturn
props.description: Called when the focused action is removed, so focus can move somewhere meaningful instead of the page.

props.name: selectedCount
props.description: Number of selected rows. The actions show only when it is greater than zero.

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal alignment of the cell's content.

props.name: scope
props.description: Marks the cell as a header for its row or column, which assistive technology uses to describe other cells.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the group header, for when the visible label needs more context.

props.name: children
props.description: Member rows of the group.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the group header section.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Adds a disclosure button that shows and hides the member rows.

props.name: colSpan
props.description: Number of columns the group header spans.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether the member rows are shown on first render, when the group owns its expanded state.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Whether the member rows are shown, for when the caller owns the expanded state.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable identifier exposed on both group sections as `data-group-id`.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label for the group header.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called with the requested expanded state when the disclosure button is activated.

props.name: onToggleSelect
props.description: Called when the reader asks to select or clear every selectable row in the group.

props.name: rowCount
props.description: Number of member rows in the group, announced alongside the label.

props.name: selection
props.description: Whether all, some, or none of the group's selectable rows are selected. Renders a group checkbox when set.

props.name: selectionDisabled
props.description: Prevents toggling the group checkbox, for when the group has no selectable rows.

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal alignment of the header's content.

props.name: data-component
props.description: Overrides the marker used to identify this element in tests and styling.

props.name: defaultPageIndex
props.description: Zero-based page shown on first render.

props.name: hrefBuilder
props.description: Builds the URL for a page, so pagination works without JavaScript.

props.name: marginPageCount
props.description: How many pages stay visible at each end of the range.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new page index when the reader pages through the table.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Number of rows shown per page.

props.name: renderPage
props.description: Renders each page link yourself, for integrating with a router.

props.name: showPages
props.description: Shows the numbered pages. Defaults to hiding them on narrow viewports, keeping only Previous and Next.

props.name: surroundingPageCount
props.description: How many pages stay visible on each side of the current one.

props.name: totalCount
props.description: Total number of rows across all pages.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the checkbox when no row header labels it.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Ids of the row header or headers that label the checkbox. The selection action is prepended automatically.

props.name: checkboxRef
props.description: Ref to the row's selection checkbox.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents selecting the row.

props.name: onToggleSelect
props.description: Called when the reader asks to select or deselect the row.

props.name: selected
props.description: Whether the row is selected.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: IDs of elements that describe the selection checkbox.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the selection checkbox.

props.name: checkboxRef
props.description: Ref to the selection checkbox, for returning focus to it.

props.name: description
props.description: Supplementary description for the selection checkbox, such as how many rows it selects.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents toggling selection, for when no rows can be selected.

props.name: onToggleSelect
props.description: Called when the reader asks to select or clear every selectable row.

props.name: selection
props.description: Whether all, some, or none of the selectable rows are selected.

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal alignment of the header's content.

props.name: direction
props.description: Current sort direction for this column.

props.name: onToggleSort
props.description: Called when the header is activated to change the sort.

props.name: cellPadding
props.description: Vertical spacing inside cells, which sets the density of the table.

props.name: columns
props.description: DataTable columns or header-only definitions whose headers, alignment, and layout the placeholder mirrors.

props.name: gridTemplateColumns
props.description: Explicit column track sizes, as a CSS grid template.

props.name: rows
props.description: Number of placeholder rows to render while data loads.

props.name: as
props.description: Native heading or paragraph element, chosen independently of the subtitle's visual style.

props.name: as
props.description: Native heading or paragraph element, chosen independently of the title's visual style.
